Create a BrickKit project, or complete one.

Two modes on the same primitive — check what a complete project has, create what is missing, leave what exists:
  brickkit init <name>   creation: makes the directory <name>/ and the full skeleton in it
  brickkit init          completion: fills in what the current directory lacks (an existing project,
                         or a component repository that becomes its own local workbench)

A complete project has brickkit.yaml (which components, which versions), deploy.yaml (how they are deployed),
config/vars.yaml (shared values), the components/ and shell/ local sources, BRICKKIT.md (the project map) and a .gitignore.
deploy.local.yaml is never created here: brickkit local on makes it when you want it.

In completion mode:
  - existing files are skipped, never touched
  - an existing .gitignore is checked, never edited: each missing required entry is a loud warning
    (without them personal deploy files and secrets get committed)
  - in a non-empty directory the plan is shown first and needs a yes (--yes skips the question)
  - the project name is --name, else the existing brickkit.yaml's project, else the directory name
  - finally the project is loaded the way lint and up load it; if that fails, the command fails

The project name: only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit
(it names the K8s namespace and the Docker network).

The AI assistant skills (.claude/skills/, AGENTS.md) are installed too; add --no-skills if you don't want them.
It never touches your CLAUDE.md.

When the project root is a Git repository root, a pre-commit hook is installed as well;
for a project nested inside someone else's repository, install it explicitly with brickkit init --hooks.

Usage:
  brickkit init [<project-name>] [flags]

Examples:
  brickkit init my-shop                 create my-shop/ with the full skeleton
  brickkit init                         complete the current directory (asks first if it is not empty)
  brickkit init --name my-shop --yes    complete without asking (CI)
  brickkit init my-shop --no-skills     don't install the AI assistant skills
  brickkit init --hooks                 only add the pre-commit hook

Flags:
  -h, --help          help for init
      --hooks         Only install the pre-commit hook used for pre-commit checks (to add it to an existing project)
      --name string   Project name in completion mode (default: the existing brickkit.yaml's project, else the directory name)
      --no-skills     Don't install the AI assistant skills (.claude/skills/, AGENTS.md)
      --yes           Complete without asking first (CI/CD)

Global Flags:
      --log-level string   Level of the JSON logs on stderr (debug | info | warn | error | off) (default "off")
